source_evidence: Leveraged loans also typically pay a variable interest rate. This means that if market interest rates go up, the interest rate on the loan will also increase.
question: How do floating interest rates on leveraged loans respond when market interest rates rise?
answer: Leveraged loans typically pay variable interest rates, so their loan rates increase when market interest rates rise. This could help protect a fund from losses due to rising rates, but it does not guarantee that the fund will avoid losses.
